evidence_refinements.observation: The released replication workspace preserves numerous failed/rejected intermediate branches before terminal acceptance: failed Gilbreth sweeps (run-0013/0014), rejected sequential full sweeps, many NLS probes, and later matched runs. Final completion is recorded only after all remaining targets are matched, report/main.pdf builds, and validate-progress, validate-report, and validate-completion all clear.
evidence_refinements.interpretation: This strengthens feasibility evidence for durable negative-run preservation plus terminal evidence-matrix completion rather than last-message completion. It also shows that a gate-compatible workflow can retain failed probes as provenance while continuing search.
evidence_refinements.scope_guard: The release still does not provide a matched otherwise-identical no-gate run, nor an observed event where an agent explicitly declared completion and the validator rejected that declaration. Treat this as implementation/process evidence, not causal efficacy of the completion gate.

evidence_refinements.observation: The deterministic ARI gate has executable tests showing strict-final blocking for a writer-reported numeric mismatch (reported 99 vs recomputed 50), unresolved operands, uncovered result numbers, wrong writer-declared assertions, and environment mismatch when comparison_scope is explicitly same_environment. The same numeric mismatch is non-blocking in draft, and warn mode does not block that class. The gate README additionally separates objective consistency from truthfulness of recorded results and states finalize_paper is skipped when final blocking remains.
evidence_refinements.interpretation: This turns candidate 037 from documentation-only design evidence into directly tested implementation semantics: the promotion gate demonstrably distinguishes draft/advisory review from strict final veto and recomputes writer claims forward from recorded operands rather than trusting prose.
evidence_refinements.scope_guard: These are software unit/integration tests over synthetic checkpoints, not a matched autonomous-science experiment showing improved scientific outcomes. They establish enforcement correctness for specified contract failures, not completeness of the contract or truth of underlying measurements.

negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: A deterministic claim gate can correctly reject declared numeric inconsistency yet still cannot verify whether recorded experimental results themselves are truthful; ARI explicitly places external reproducibility outside this gate boundary.
Successful final completion after many rejected probes does not by itself show that the completion gate caused better scientific fidelity; a no-gate matched comparator remains missing.
Metadata-only common-task verification is not evidence about trajectory-level repair behavior. The W4390519793 coding block remains pending until primary trajectory bodies are actually accessible.
